# KBD Constraints — Charcoal Agent

Generated by `/kbd-init` on 2026-09-23. The project has no `AGENTS.md` "Never Do"
section, so the blocking rules below are the generic KBD defaults adapted to this
stack (Vite/React/TypeScript + Tauri shell) plus rules derived from `CLAUDE.md`.

Commands use `npm` (Dockerfile builds with `npm ci`; `package-lock.json` is the
authoritative lockfile). No mandatory command wrapper or `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` policy
is defined for this project.

Path ownership: `.claude/`, `.agents/`, `.opencode/`, `.kimi-code/` and `openspec/`
are repository-owned tool configuration (OpenSpec skills/commands), not disposable
state — do not delete or regenerate them as part of a change. Reference workspace
folders (see `project.json` → `workspace.folders`) are read-only.

---

## Blocking Constraints (prevent archiving until resolved)

```yaml
constraints:
  - id: build-passes
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Vite production build must pass'
    command: 'npm run build'

  - id: tests-pass
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Vitest suite must pass (skills-sync integration test self-skips without a UAR)'
    command: 'npm test'

  - id: no-console-log-in-commits
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No console.log in committed TypeScript (console.error/warn for real error paths is allowed)'
    check: "grep -rn 'console\\.log' src/ --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx'"

  - id: no-any-type
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No new `: any` in TypeScript source (1 pre-existing occurrence at init; do not add more)'
    check: "grep -rn ': any' src/ --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx'"

  - id: no-hardcoded-secrets
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No hardcoded API keys/tokens; UAR auth comes only from VITE_UAR_API_KEY'
    check: "grep -rn 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]\\{8,\\}\\|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9]\\{16,\\}' src/"

  - id: no-env-files-committed
    severity: blocking
    description: '.env and .env.*.local must never be committed (only .env.example)'
    check: "git ls-files | grep -E '^\\.env($|\\.)' | grep -v '^\\.env\\.example$'"

  - id: reference-folders-read-only
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No writes to reference workspace folders (UAR, artifact-refiner, openfang)'
    note: 'Changes to the UAR contract are made in that repo separately; this project only consumes it'

  - id: pglite-migrations-append-only
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Existing entries in MIGRATIONS (src/lib/db/pglite.ts) must not be edited; add a new version instead'
    note: 'Review git diff of src/lib/db/pglite.ts'

  - id: pglite-not-prebundled
    severity: blocking
    description: '@electric-sql/pglite must remain in vite.config.ts optimizeDeps.exclude'
    check: "grep -q 'exclude: \\[\"@electric-sql/pglite\"\\]' vite.config.ts || echo MISSING"
```

---

## Warning Constraints (acknowledge before archiving)

```yaml
constraints:
  - id: no-lint-warnings
    severity: warning
    description: 'ESLint clean'
    command: 'npm run lint'

  - id: agui-contract-parity
    severity: warning
    description: 'New/changed AG-UI event handling in use-message-stream.ts matches UAR src/uar/api/sse.rs'
    note: 'Cross-check against the reference folder; flows are type → store action → stream case → render component'

  - id: assistant-ui-metadata
    severity: warning
    description: 'Every ThreadMessageLike produced in use-chat-runtime.ts carries metadata (and user messages attachments: [])'
    note: 'Manual review — missing fields crash @assistant-ui/react internals'

  - id: shadcn-components
    severity: warning
    description: 'UI uses shadcn/ui components from src/components/ui rather than raw HTML controls'

  - id: tests-for-new-features
    severity: warning
    description: 'Tests exist for new hooks, stores and utilities added in this change'

  - id: no-stub-comments
    severity: warning
    description: 'No TODO/FIXME/STUB/HACK comments in committed code'
    check: "grep -rn 'TODO\\|FIXME\\|STUB\\|HACK' src/"

  - id: accessibility-basics
    severity: warning
    description: 'New UI components have aria-label or semantic HTML'
    note: 'Manual review required'
```

---

## Workflow Triggers

```yaml
workflow_triggers:
  - event: on_iteration_complete
    action:
      type: command
      target: 'npm run build'

  - event: on_change_complete
    action:
      type: command
      target: 'npm test && npm run lint'

  - event: on_refinement_complete
    action:
      type: command
      target: "git add -A && git commit -m 'kbd: refine <change-id>'"
```

## Why

Operator decision D-003 (2026-09-23): the app's shadcn/ui primitives must be on **Base UI** at the latest shadcn (4.21.x), not Radix. shadcn encodes the primitive library in the `components.json` style (`radix-*` vs `base-*`), and the assistant-ui registry resolves Base UI component variants from that style, so this change is a prerequisite for `assistant-ui-latest` and for the token-driven rebrand, which restyles these primitives.

## What Changes

- Switch `components.json` to the `base-nova` style (Tailwind 4 layout, lucide icons) and add `@base-ui/react`.
- Re-install only the 16 primitives with live consumers (`alert, avatar, button, card, collapsible, dialog, input, label, scroll-area, select, separator, sonner, switch, tabs, textarea, tooltip`) as Base UI variants.
- **Delete** the 33 primitives without live consumers (accordion, alert-dialog, aspect-ratio, badge, breadcrumb, calendar, carousel, chart, checkbox, command, context-menu, drawer, dropdown-menu, form, hover-card, input-otp, menubar, navigation-menu, pagination, popover, progress, radio-group, resizable, sheet, sidebar, skeleton, slider, table, toggle, toggle-group, and the shadcn `toast`/`toaster`/`use-toast` trio). Counts corrected during task 1.1: consumers inside deleted dead files do not count.
- **Delete** dead components with no consumers that would otherwise have to be migrated: `components/assistant-ui/{thread,markdown-text,tool-fallback,assistant-modal,assistant-sidebar,thread-list}.tsx` `components/chat/*`, and the then-unreferenced `hooks/use-threads.ts` + `stores/thread-store.ts` (planned for `assistant-ui-latest`; moved here because they block this migration).
- Update every call site of the migrated primitives to Base UI APIs (`asChild` → `render`; `onValueChange`/`onCheckedChange`/`onOpenChange` receive an extra event-details argument; `data-state` selectors → `data-open`/`data-closed`).
- One toast system: keep Sonner, driven by the app's own theme store instead of an unmounted `next-themes` provider; remove the shadcn `Toaster`.
- **BREAKING (internal):** remove all `@radix-ui/*` direct dependencies and `next-themes`.

Out of scope: visual restyling (tokens arrive in `knowme-brand-tokens`); assistant-ui primitives (they carry their own `asChild` API until `assistant-ui-latest`).

- `ui-primitives`: keyboard and pointer behavior of the app's overlay and form primitives (dialogs, selects, tooltips, switches, collapsibles, tabs). Sheets are out of scope: the `sheet` primitive had no consumers and was deleted.

## Surface after migration

- Deleted: 33 unused primitives, dead assistant-ui/chat components, `hooks/use-threads.ts`, `stores/thread-store.ts`, and 10 npm packages used only by deleted primitives.

## Issues found and fixed during migration
1. **shadcn CLI 4.21 installed an npm package literally named `cn`** (the registry lists the `cn` utility as a dependency) and emitted `import { cn } from "cn"` in 14 files instead of the `@/lib/utils` alias. Reverted the package, rewrote imports. It also ran bun because a stale `bun.lockb` exists; the change to `bun.lockb` was reverted.
2. **Missing `shadcn/tailwind.css`.** Switching the style by editing `components.json` (not `shadcn init`) skipped the base-nova CSS dependency, so custom variants like `data-horizontal:` / `data-open:` did not exist — Tabs rendered side-by-side. Added `shadcn` as an exact dev dependency and `@import 'shadcn/tailwind.css'`; removed the now-duplicate Radix-only accordion keyframes.
3. **Select shows labels only with `items`.** Base UI `Select.Value` renders the raw value otherwise; every Select root now passes `items`. `onValueChange` can pass `null` (hidden by `strictNullChecks: false`); all handlers guard it.
4. **Sonner used `var(--popover)`**, which in this project is an RGB channel triplet, not a color → switched to `--color-*` tokens and to the app theme store (next-themes was never mounted).
5. jsdom lacks `PointerEvent` (polyfilled in `src/test/setup.ts`) and layout, so focus trapping and Select navigation are verified in a real browser via `e2e/harness/primitives.html` (served by Vite in dev/e2e only; not part of `vite build`).
